review_level: Fresh PRIMARY screening only; not independent second review, original approval or Pass/Collect
original_unique_math: Independently take unit-cube vertices P=(0,0,0), Q=(0,1,1), R=(1,1,1), S=(1,1,0) by following the actual diagonal/edge incidences. At P, PQ=(0,1,1), PS=(1,1,0), dot=1 and norms=sqrt(2), hence angle60. At Q, QP=(0,-1,-1) and QR=(1,0,0) have dot0. At R, RQ=(-1,0,0) and RS=(0,0,-1) have dot0. At S, SR=(0,0,1) and SP=(-1,-1,0) have dot0. The original arcs choose these four nonreflex angles, so the sum is60+90+90+90=330, uniquely B. Screen angles and the planar quadrilateral theorem are inapplicable. No optimization is asked.
native_actual_image_inspection: Personally viewed source JPG, formal PNG, old red-loop PNG and r61 blue-local-ray PNG. All four original arcs remain distinct, the three hidden cube edges remain dashed, and all existing edges/diagonals retain their endpoints. The short blue intervals touch R on the two true perpendicular cube edges and P on its two distinct-face diagonals. The rest of the path remains black, so this is not the old complete-loop image.
human_semantics: Two real ray pairs are compared. A blue pair is neither an equal-angle glyph nor a right-angle box; the old arc at P still selects the actual spatial60-degree angle. Any interpretation as colored edges changes appearance only, with the cube and its four marked angles fixed. No printed-pattern output or painted-target count is involved.

every_marker_roles.role: cube011_cube111 interval0.75..1: source RQ ray near R, on the upper cube edge.
cube110_cube111 interval0.75..1: source RS ray near R, supplies the other side of the genuine square-face90-degree angle.
diagPQ interval0..0.25: receiver PQ near P, first face diagonal, with the original P arc still readable.
diagPS interval0..0.25: receiver PS near P, second face diagonal, making the local true60-degree pair. Together the receivers invite a false transfer of90, predicting360=D.

limits: Primary assessment is not an independent review or a human performance study.
No original control is required or repeated; any two observations establish observed hits only, not causal gain.
Zero-call and fresh-render gates are separate and must pass before copying/testing.
